description: Source code for a Linux kernel driver for WorldSemi WS2812B individually-addressable LEDs using SPI interface.

classes.name: ws2812b_led
classes.description: Represents an individual WS2812B LED with multiple color components.

classes.name: ws2812b_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for the driver, containing configuration and state.

methods.name: ws2812b_set_byte
methods.description: Converts a byte of data into 3-byte SPI data representing pulses for WS2812B protocol.

methods.name: ws2812b_set
methods.description: Sets the brightness of an LED by preparing SPI data and transmitting it.

methods.name: ws2812b_probe
methods.description: Initializes the driver when the device is detected, setting up LEDs and SPI communication.
